no_tuning: No result-driven change to sources, forcings, fixtures, selectors, windows, adapters, tolerances, aggregation, checkpoint grouping, or decision predicates is permitted in this namespace.

endpoint_matrix.paired_control: every enabled cell has a same-source/same-forcing disabled control
endpoint_matrix.current_selector_equivalence: current/development and current/canonical each prove legacy selector equals explicit sequential_resolved_shadow_v1

factorial_effects_per_water_year.aggregation_order: compute each effect for each WY first; summarize effect samples with Python statistics.median; never subtract separately reduced medians

build_custody.checkout: isolated shared local clone below namespace; detached exact SHA; clean verification
build_custody.cargo_home_seed: copy only registry/{cache,index,src} and git/{checkouts,db} from the ambient read-only Cargo home into namespace/cargo-home; exclude credentials, credentials.toml, config, config.toml, env, and installed-bin metadata; record a sorted path/size/SHA-256 manifest and aggregate manifest SHA-256 before use
build_custody.environment: scrub OPENWEPP_*, RUSTFLAGS, CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS; set CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true, package-local CARGO_HOME, and checkpoint-specific CARGO_TARGET_DIR
record: package-local Cargo home manifest and aggregate SHA-256

checkpoint_grouping.digest: LC_ALL=C git ls-tree -r REV -- Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml .cargo crates | sha256sum
checkpoint_grouping.selection: retain base and first commit at each consecutive digest transition; canonical lane executes iff any WY E10-E00 exceeds max(1e-6 J m^-2, 1e-12*sum_abs_operands) or the paired-difference median exceeds 1e-7 MJ m^-2; development lane uses the same WY-or-median rule for E11-E01; execute both when both trigger

reconstruction.historical_estimand: schema-v4 stage3_shadow_complete_energy_j_m2 daily values summed from October 1 through earliest maximum positive observed SWE date inclusive, then Python statistics.median across WY1990-2024
reconstruction.current_estimand: schema-v6 ordered tuple legacy_sequential_complete_j_m2, independently reconstructed as complete_external_flux_w_m2*duration_seconds+internal_active_lower_conduction_j_m2 at tuple/hour/day/WY levels
reconstruction.date_join: exact unique date; reject duplicate, missing, unordered, or out-of-cohort rows

v4_aggregate_custody_only.applicability_context: stage3_energy_enabled is retained context; zero hourly/daily aggregate values do not prove support or N/A
v4_aggregate_custody_only.sign_units: positive toward snow; J m^-2 for hourly-bin energy and daily energy
v4_aggregate_custody_only.closure: sum exactly 24 hourly complete energy values equals daily complete energy within energy_tolerance_j_m2

v6_primitive_and_aggregate.sign_units: positive energy and vapor mass toward snow; flux W m^-2; duration s; energy J m^-2; mass kg m^-2
v6_primitive_and_aggregate.applicability: support only when tuple applicable=true/reason=evaluated and matching hourly status evaluated; null is N/A; numeric zero is not an absent-support alias

schema_adapters.cross_schema_limit: E00/E01 versus E10/E11 effects contrast only the common aggregate complete-energy estimand; no primitive, support, state, or mechanistic effect is inferred

forcing_identity_difference_scope: emit only for a comparison whose two forcing SHA-256 values differ, including retained E00 versus E11; it does not suppress valid E00/E10 or E01/E11 fixed-forcing contrasts

forcing_matched_predecessor_gate.predicate: for forcing hash H, compare current cell and old cell at H; all 35 paired WY aggregate differences must satisfy energy_tolerance_j_m2 and statistics.median of paired differences must satisfy median_tolerance_mj_m2
forcing_matched_predecessor_gate.sfq_binding: an S/F/Q causal class requires the gate for the exact S/F/Q forcing hash; prior development S/F/Q requires development closure; canonical closure cannot substitute
forcing_matched_predecessor_gate.canonical_claim_limit: this package does not adjudicate canonical S/F/Q unless canonical S, F, and Q are separately produced under the frozen operator protocol

source_invariant_predicate: SOURCE_INVARIANT_WITHIN_FORCING[H] requires every one of 35 paired WY source deltas at H within energy_tolerance_j_m2 and their median within median_tolerance_mj_m2

axes.DAILY_RESET_CAUSAL: replace only the parent day-start clone/reset construction with the child's day-start clone/reset construction
axes.INITIAL_CONTROL_VOLUME_PROJECTION_CAUSAL: replace only the parent first active-volume alignment/normalization/membership projection with the child's
axes.SURFACE_TERMS_CAUSAL: replace only the parent complete external surface-term operator outputs for identical primitive inputs with the child's
axes.ACTIVE_INTERNAL_CONDUCTION_CAUSAL: replace only the parent active-to-lower internal-conduction transfer with the child's equal-and-opposite transfer
axes.STATE_APPLICATION_REMOVAL_CAUSAL: replace only the parent cold/melt/sublimation/deposition state-application and removal transition with the child's
axes.TRANSITION_PREPARATION_CADENCE_CAUSAL: replace only the parent post-substep alignment/normalization/coalescence timing and next-substep cadence transition with the child's

localization_classes.common_predicate: same exact source input, forcing hash, fixture hashes, selectors, date/window, and upstream operand to_bits; identically instrumented parent/child twins each behavior-neutral versus its uninstrumented endpoint; exactly one named parent-to-child substitution; affected tuple, day, every one of 35 WY deltas, and median close under frozen tolerances; every other single-axis substitution fails closure
localization_classes.equifinality: if zero or multiple substitutions close, emit only MULTIFACTOR_OR_UNOBSERVED_PREDECESSOR_BOUNDARY
localization_classes.forcing_interaction: if both forcing lanes trigger and first divergent interval or axis differs, emit only MULTIFACTOR_OR_UNOBSERVED_PREDECESSOR_BOUNDARY plus SOURCE_BY_FORCING_INTERACTION_DESCRIPTIVE; do not select the cleaner lane

versioned_estimands_reconciled_meaning: exact algebraic aggregate custody accounting only; not mechanistic explanation

allowed: historical executable absent and exact-source semantic replay impossible
exact source cannot build or execute after frozen compatibility procedure
genuinely unobserved boundary after all in-scope instrumentation and tests
